subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a wizard who has communed with Lolth and speaks through his body, claiming to have been reduced to a small spider and then reconstituted, anchoring his claim in the observable presence of the spider.
source_quote: I am… you are not speaking to the wizard of this body. I… he… this body has communed with Lolth. And I… I am speaking through this body.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree suspects Daz of being a charlatan but reframes his deception as a divine test of her discernment, believing she has passed and that Daz is a genuine follower of Lolth.
source_quote: you are trying to test me, to see if I was one of those fake followers of Lolth, who are willing to believe every charlatan magic user that is somehow being possessed by the power of Lolth.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree later reinterprets the spider, lights, and reverence as signs of fungal infection by Zuggtmoy, questioning whether Daz is a victim rather than a deceiver.
source_quote: have you two been infected by the spores, possessed by the crazed magic of Zuggtmoy? convinced of the bride's power? Is this another trick of Ilvara's?

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree reveals that Ilvara, once a high priestess of Lolth, has become seduced by the idea that Lolth wishes to be married and now spreads fungal corruption, turning allies into mindless fungal creatures.
source_quote: Ilvara, who was once a high priestess of Lolth, has become seduced by this abomination, this idea that Lolth wishes to be married. There is something foul and stinking about her, and then all of those allies she seems to covet have turned into fungal creatures that are mindless.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree admits she cannot approach Ilvara herself due to fear of contamination and requires Daz and his allies to carry out the assassination.
source_quote: I was not going to kill her. That is what you… where you come in.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree flinches at physical contact, revealing a deep, personal fear of fungal contamination from prolonged exposure to Zuggtmoy’s influence.
source_quote: Don't touch me.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asserts that his conviction as a follower of Lolth is genuine and unique to him, rejecting Asha’s assumption that his behavior deviates from orthodox worship.
source_quote: It's the kind of conviction this follower of Lolth shows.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir observes that Asha Vandree treats him as invisible furniture during negotiations, addressing all questions and demands solely to Daz despite his physical presence.
source_quote: She filed me away and returned her eyes to Daz. Not a glance afterward. Not a word in my direction for the duration of the conversation.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir notes that Daz’s response to Asha’s fungal infection theory — 'I really do believe that I have' — used hesitation as texture to make conviction feel lived-in and authentic.
source_quote: I really do believe that I have. Perhaps there are some spores within me, but I… it feels… I feel it.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, a gelatinous cube meant to be an inanimate familiar, attempts to form an utterance during negotiation, nearly exposing the deception.
source_quote: The ooze had, apparently, opinions about the negotiation. It began to form the shape of an utterance — which is not something you want from what is supposed to be an inanimate ooze familiar.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is described as failing at the simple task of being a rock, having been given clear instructions to remain motionless and silent.
source_quote: Glabbagool was doing what Glabbagool does. Which is to say: failing at the very simple task of being a rock.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum reveals he possesses three 4th-level spells — Glyph of Warding, Dust of Suleiman, and Phantasmal Killer — but only one 4th-level spell slot, forcing a critical choice among them.
source_quote: So these powerful spells I've been talking about… they're all 4th level, and I only have one fourth level slot. I can only cast one.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum describes Phantasmal Killer as a spell that taps into a creature’s deepest fears, creating an illusory manifestation that can cause 4d10 psychic damage if the target fails consecutive Wisdom saving throws.
source_quote: It says you tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears. They become frightened if they fail a wisdom saving throw, and if they fail the saving throw in each turn — and it can last up to a minute — then they take 4 die 10 psychic damage.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum explains that Dust of Suleiman creates a 20-foot sphere at 120-foot range that deals 20 points of damage per turn to anything inside it.
source_quote: Which I can cast at a 120-foot distance. It creates a 20-foot sphere, and anything inside this sphere takes 20 points of damage per turn.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum describes Glyph of Warding as a spell inscribed in a location that triggers when a creature moves across it, executing its effect automatically.
source_quote: It's a… the spell is Glyph of Warding… You inscribe it in a particular place, and then when somebody triggers it by moving across it, it does its thing.

subject: Underdark cavern
fact: The Underdark cavern contains fungal growths, a gelatinous cube disguised as a rock, and a zone of Darkness placed behind the party’s position as a fallback.
source_quote: I placed a zone of Darkness behind our position — not at the entrance, not anywhere Ilvara might notice the edge of it and understand what was coming. Behind us. A fallback. A place to pull someone if the line broke.

subject: Heart Fungus
fact: The Heart Fungus is identified as a mushroom artifact that is not the vector of infection — the spores are Ilvara’s, and the artifact is a secondary risk to be destroyed.
source_quote: The critical detail — the Heart Fungus itself wasn't the vector. The spores were Ilvara's. The artifact was the other risk.

subject: Spores of Ilvara
fact: The spores of Ilvara are the true vector of fungal corruption, spreading madness and transforming allies into mindless fungal creatures.
source_quote: The spores were Ilvara's.

subject: Zuggtmoy's influence
fact: Zuggtmoy’s influence is perceived as a source of fungal madness capable of infecting minds and causing hallucinations of divine presence.
source_quote: possessed by the crazed magic of Zuggtmoy? convinced of the bride's power?

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara was once a high priestess of Lolth but has become obsessed with the idea that Lolth wishes to be married, spreading fungal corruption and turning followers into mindless fungal creatures.
source_quote: Ilvara, who was once a high priestess of Lolth, has become seduced by this abomination, this idea that Lolth wishes to be married. There is something foul and stinking about her, and then all of those allies she seems to covet have turned into fungal creatures that are mindless.

subject: Daz’s inner state
fact: Daz’s inner state is described as having been reduced and reconstituted through a ritual involving a spider and luminous lights, culminating in the sensation of Lolth’s presence within him.
source_quote: The luminescence built. Condensed. The shape of the Spider Queen herself, reduced and reduced and *reduced* until it shrank into that small skittering body and seemed to pass directly into mine.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz claims to have convinced others to join him in his mission, implying a network of followers who believe in his divine connection.
source_quote: I've convinced others to join me.

subject: Lolth’s gratitude
fact: Asha Vandree offers 'the gratitude of Lolth' as a reward, which Daz claims he already feels, suggesting internalized devotion over material gain.
source_quote: The gratitude of Lolth… I already feel the gratitude of Lolth.

subject: Asha Vandree’s mental state
fact: Asha Vandree’s mental state is shaped by paranoid devotion to Lolth, where suspicion has become its own kind of faith, causing her to reinterpret deception as divine testing.
source_quote: the look of someone who has spent so long in paranoid devotion that suspicion has become its own kind of faith.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is referenced by Asha as the authority who decided to use the Dust of Suleiman on the Heart Fungus rather than on Ilvara directly, based on Asha's tactical insight.
source_quote: I took the note. I filed it. I did not say anything I would regret.

subject: Asha Vandree
fact: Asha Vandree is referenced by Grygum as the authority who decided the fate of failed Drow, and whose territory was the politics of this cavern and the hierarchy of what needed to die in what order to make the rest of it possible.
source_quote: The politics of this cavern — the power structures, the hierarchy of what needed to die in what order to make the rest of it possible — that was Asha Vandree's territory, and I knew it.

subject: Heart Fungus
fact: The Heart Fungus is the mechanism of Ilvara's control over the whole area, and killing it dismantles the architecture of her power.
source_quote: The Heart Fungus was the key. That was her point, and she wasn't wrong. The fungus was how Ilvara kept control over the whole area. Kill the fungus and you don't just hurt Ilvara — you dismantle the architecture of her power.

subject: Dust of Suleiman
fact: The Dust of Suleiman was originally imagined to be poured directly on Ilvara, but was later recognized as more valuable as infrastructure demolition targeting the Heart Fungus.
source_quote: The Dust of Suleiman, which I had been imagining pouring down on Ilvara directly, was actually more valuable as infrastructure demolition.

subject: Glyph of Warding
fact: The Glyph of Warding was inscribed on the bridge to detonate against anyone approaching from the side Jorlan is on, and does not distinguish between friend and foe.
source_quote: I finished the inscription and straightened up. The bridge was now a threshold. Everything on the far side of it was already committed to a detonation it didn't know about yet.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is one of only three people no longer captured by Ilvara's spores, because he hates Ilvara for something or other, and was once in an affair with her.
source_quote: The only three people who are no longer captured by her spores are myself and Jorlan... I mean, they used to have an affair, it used to be this whole thing, and then she broke up with him, and then he was bitter because she broke up with him.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is visibly infected by spores, serving as a visual aid that the spores are not theoretical but a real and present danger.
source_quote: Zalthir gestured toward Daz. 'I mean, — look at him! He's already infected. I don't want to be infected.'

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is an ooze that was introduced as Daz's familiar to explain its presence, despite being a sentient entity capable of blinking and not minding the mislabeling.
source_quote: Thorin solved it with characteristic practicality. 'Will Glabbagool be offended if we refer to him as a familiar? I think that's probably the easiest way to just explain it away,' he muttered. Then the dwarf introduced Glabbagool as Daz's familiar.

subject: Spore Servants
fact: Spore Servants are former drow of the party who have totally succumbed to Ilvara's power, embracing her claims about the bride being Lolth's manifestation and now exist as hollowed-out walking consequences.
source_quote: They are the drow of our party whom have totally succumbed to Ilvara's power... There were those who foolishly believed Ilvara's claims about how the bride was Lolth's further manifestation, and who embraced the spores and the ecstasy that came through them.

subject: Mushroom Artifact
fact: The mushroom artifact, picked up in Gracklstugh in the Whorlstone Caverns, leaves a marker on those who touched it that can be exploited by the Heart Fungus.
source_quote: Whatever we'd picked up in Gracklstugh in the Whorlstone Caverns when we visited the pocket dimension, had left a marker on us. The mushroom artifact could exploit it.

subject: Bridge
fact: The bridge is the threshold where the Glyph of Warding was inscribed, and where Jorlan was lured to trigger its detonation, shifting the tactical balance of the battle.
source_quote: Jorlan charges. He comes straight onto the bridge, straight onto the glyph, and the detonation is immediate and total — 21 damage, one spore servant gone to nothing...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir raised the broader concern about spores and proposed the final tactical plan to teleport into Ilvara, grapple her, and drop her into the area of effect of the Dust of Suleiman.
source_quote: Zalthir, bless him, raised the broader concern about spores. He'd been thinking about it — we all had. 'I can try to grab Ilvara and drop her into that, such that you're hurting both of them, and then the rest of you can fireball or whatever from there.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin was given Grygum's light crossbow to compensate for his lack of ranged capability, and used it to hold the line before engaging Jorlan in melee with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: I can lend — I can lend you my light crossbow... I took it, because I'd rather be in the fight badly than out of it entirely... Now I have Dawnbringer in hand...

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is corrupted by fungal growth, preoccupied with the mushroom token, and her power is sustained by the Heart Fungus, which she uses to control the entire area.
source_quote: She was on an elevated platform. Corrupted. The fungal growth had changed her in ways that were specific and terrible — the scourge still in her hand, but everything else altered. She was preoccupied with the mushroom token.

subject: Whorlstone Caverns
fact: The Whorlstone Caverns are the location where the group visited a pocket dimension and acquired the mushroom artifact that leaves a marker on those who touched it.
source_quote: Whatever we'd picked up in Gracklstugh in the Whorlstone Caverns when we visited the pocket dimension, had left a marker on us.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is the location where the group visited a pocket dimension and acquired the mushroom artifact that leaves a marker on those who touched it.
source_quote: Whatever we'd picked up in Gracklstugh in the Whorlstone Caverns when we visited the pocket dimension, had left a marker on us.

subject: Battle of the Heart Fungus
fact: The Battle of the Heart Fungus began with Zalthir teleporting to Ilvara, triggering the Heart Fungus’s spore cloud, summoning spore servants, and culminating in Jorlan triggering the Glyph of Warding, allowing Thorin to engage in melee.
source_quote: The plan was always going to start without me... Zalthir vanish — just gone, teleported straight to her — and then there's the crack of his fists... The Heart Fungus has been sitting... unleashes a cloud of spores... Then the spore servants come up out of the ground... Jorlan charges... the detonation is immediate and total...

subject: Inspection of the Glyph
fact: Grygum inscribed the Glyph of Warding on the bridge, acknowledging the moral dilemma that it cannot distinguish between friend and foe, and chose to trigger it on Jorlan's approach.
source_quote: I don't know how to inscribe a glyph that will only kill the drow that we don't like... Okay, and then, I guess the trigger is — anyone approaching from the side that Jorlan is on.

subject: Tactical Handoff of the Crossbow
fact: Grygum handed his light crossbow to Thorin to enable ranged contribution, recognizing that everyone needs a way to contribute when the fight starts.
source_quote: I can lend — I can lend you my light crossbow... I handed it over and hoped he wouldn't need it.

subject: Revelation of Asha's Emotional State
fact: Asha revealed genuine exasperation about Jorlan's unresolved romantic history with Ilvara, showing vulnerability and humanity inconsistent with her prior contempt for Grygum.
source_quote: I agree! ... Like, you would think that in the midst of the abyss with the demons, everyone could get over their relationship issues, but no, no, no, no, no — Jorlan still is complaining that Ilvara… Ilvara this and Ilvara that.

subject: Revelation of Asha's Belief in Ilvara's Spore Origin
fact: Asha stated 'I believe' regarding the origin of the spore illness, undermining her authority and revealing uncertainty in what she had previously presented as fact.
source_quote: The particular spore illness only originates from Ilvara's spores and from her mushroom... I believe.

subject: Introduction of Glabbagool as a Familiar
fact: Glabbagool was introduced as Daz's familiar to explain his presence, and Asha's expression shifted from alarmed to impressed upon learning this, elevating Daz's perceived status.
source_quote: Asha considered this. Her expression shifted from alarmed to — and I watched this happen in real time — impressed. 'An ooze familiar,' she said, looking at Daz now with something approaching respect.

subject: Jorlan's Charge onto the Glyph
fact: Thorin lured Jorlan onto the Glyph of Warding by shouting 'Come get it, idiot!' causing a detonation that killed one spore servant and damaged the Heart Fungus.
source_quote: 'Come get it, idiot!' ... Jorlan charges. He comes straight onto the bridge, straight onto the glyph, and the detonation is immediate and total — 21 damage, one spore servant gone to nothing...

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is the son of the Ember Vanguard, flanked by a dead man's fungal corpse while the fight rages in all directions around him.
source_quote: Thorin, son of the Ember Vanguard, flanked by a dead man's fungal corpse while the fight rages in all directions around him.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin adjusts his footing.
source_quote: I adjust my footing.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is grinding the Heart Fungus down with something that sounds like the word *Suleiman* and delivers twenty force damage per turn like a promise.
source_quote: Grygum is grinding the Heart Fungus down with something that sounds like the word *Suleiman* and delivers twenty force damage per turn like a promise.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz opens up with a Fireball shaped so precisely around his allies that it catches Ilvara and her precious mushroom icon in the center of it, 24 damage worth of fire finding her even through her save, and the icon smolders.
source_quote: Daz opens up with a Fireball shaped so precisely around his allies that it catches Ilvara and her precious mushroom icon in the center of it, 24 damage worth of fire finding her even through her save, and the icon smolders.

subject: Ilvara
fact: Ilvara is bleeding.
source_quote: Ilvara is bleeding.

subject: Heart Fungus
fact: The Heart Fungus is burning.
source_quote: The mushroom is burning.

subject: Jorlan
fact: Jorlan is still in front of me.
source_quote: Jorlan is still in front of me.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is still in my hand.
source_quote: Dawnbringer is still in my hand.
